description: Pure, testable analysis in app/services/team_analysis.py returning a structured report. Compute: (1) defensive profile — per-type multiplier per member using the existing type-chart/matchup data, flag shared team weaknesses (types that hit 3+ members super-effectively) and uncovered resistances; (2) offensive coverage — set of attacking types available across members' selected damaging moves (fallback to STAB types if no moves set), list types the team can't hit at least neutrally; (3) role/stat balance — classify each member (fast sweeper / wall / bulky attacker / support) from base stats & BST, flag missing roles/speed tiers; (4) per-slot optimization — recommend best ability from the species' set and an EV/nature spread grounded in that species' top base stats and ev_yield; (5) vs-opponent diff — given an opponent team, which opponent members threaten which of ours and gaps to patch. No LLM here — deterministic data functions the coach and UI both consume.
title: Team analysis engine (coverage, weaknesses, roles, vs-opponent)
